email.body1:
Tristan, saw Trackforce ship new TrackTik field-accountability features and the cyber-physical convergence report this quarter.

When product momentum picks up, the bottleneck is rarely intent data, it is signal-to-action latency: by the time a rep acts on a signal, the moment has passed. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, personalized outreach automatically, so the team converts more of the same data: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Trackforce off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress around 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Tristan, quick follow-up for Trackforce.

Most RevOps teams know where the funnel leaks but cannot get reps to act on signals fast enough, and data hygiene eats the hours that should go to follow-up. That latency is usually the biggest measurable drag on conversion.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Tristan, last bit of proof for Trackforce.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Trackforce's reply rate likely compares to peer software vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Tristan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting signal-to-action latency is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters right after a product release, and I know the operational lift behind new features is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your ops motion? I will tailor it to Trackforce either way.
